title: 1899 Note the wooden pier foundations in the river
description: This postcard, issued in 1899, shows piers in the river upon close inspection. The original piers were constructed from wood in a grid pattern and filled with rocks gathered from local farmers’ fields. During major renovations between 1920 and 1922, the wooden piers were replaced.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
